heat.name: Heat
heat.desc: Fire and warmth. Strong against Binding and organic armor.

cold.name: Cold
cold.desc: Frost and stillness. Strong against fast, agile enemies.

force.name: Force
force.desc: Raw push and impact. Strong against armored and constructed enemies.

motion.name: Motion
motion.desc: Speed and redirection. Strong against evasive enemies.

binding.name: Binding
binding.desc: Holds and snares. Strong against beasts and swarms.

light.name: Light
light.desc: Radiance. Strong against undead, shadow and the hidden.
